Thanks, Soojin. A few technical specifics from infra that the AV team will need to support the demos and give us graceful degradation: 

• VPN egress: we will provide a /30 NATed IP pair for the demo laptops to use. AV vendor should NAT outbound traffic to this IPs.
• Firewall: allow outbound ports TCP 443, 1194 (OpenVPN) and UDP 500/4500 if IPsec fallback is needed.
• STUN/TURN: if any WebRTC-based demos are used, please ensure STUN/TURN reachability (we prefer relay over TURN).
• Bandwidth reservation: request 150 Mbps dedicated for Oct 18 between 08:00-18:00 PT; traffic will be limited to demo workstations and presenter laptops.

On AV routing and codecs:
• Confirm the Polycom trunk supports G.722 and H.264 baseline for video passthrough.
• For streaming the plenary to remote stakeholders, we will use a managed RTMP ingest; please test with a 720p stream at 3.5 Mbps and a 1080p fallback at 6 Mbps.

Fallback plan: if the dedicated VLAN is not provisioned, AVCo should bring a cellular uplink kit (two bonded LTE modems) to guarantee demo continuity.

Marcus
